items.title: MemX – my AI agent remembers I hate capsicum on pizza
items.raw_excerpt:
Like everyone else in 2025 who thought “just slap a vector DB on it” would create a coherent long-term agent, I watched my Python sidekick slowly turn into a forgetful goldfish with hoarding issues. Classic failure mode: User (day 1): “My favorite editor is VSCode”
User (day 47): “Actually switched to Cursor”
Agent (day 92): “You love VSCode, right?” Or the memory index slowly becoming this: User prefers Python
User REALLY prefers Python
Python is basically the user's personality All equally weighted. Forever. Vector search is great at similarity, but terrible at current truth. Human memory fades old opinions and overwrites bad takes.
My agent? Eternal archive of everything I ever said. So I built MemX as a small experiment: what happens if an agent’s memory actually has a lifecycle? Thing

As a dedicated OpenClaw solution for enterprises, security is the core advantage of Tencent Cloud ADP Claw. ADP Claw has established five security "firewalls" covering the entire chain, providing comprehensive "safety vault" protection for enterprise-grade AI agents.

items.title: 卓驭端到端 4.0 落地红旗，数据驱动「泛化」战打响
items.raw_excerpt: 3 月13 日，智驾方案商卓驭在深圳举办了“高悟性端到端 4.0”体验日。在这座以路况复杂著称的城市，卓驭试图通过对老城区窄路、人车混行街区的实测，验证其最新版本 OTA 在真实环境中的处理能力。 在深圳南头古城片区，极窄的城中村道路与盲区频现的十字路口，构成了智驾系统的考场。实测显示，卓驭端到端 4.0 在处理这些无法穷尽规则的场景时，表现出了明显的拟人化特征。 最典型的例子是系统对博弈的理解。在双向单车道的狭窄缝隙中，车辆能与对向来车进行空间博弈，灵巧绕开临停车辆。此外，其“端到端驱动三点式掉头”，让车辆在断头路等极端环境下，能像老司机一样自主规划路径并完成多次揉库，全程无需接管。 这种进化的核心逻辑在于彻底抛弃规则代码。 “业界许多方案中还有不少是规则代码在起作用。而端到端 4.0 是真正让数据说话。”卓驭科技产品总监蒋卓键表示。所谓“100% 端味”，意味着从感知到决策再到控制的完整链条中，以往依赖的大量人工预设规则已被拿掉，取而代之的是由海量数据训练出的 AI 大模型。 传统基于规则的系统如同一个拿着指令手册的操作员，遇到手册外的情况便会不知所措，而端到端模型则更像是一个通过大量实战学习经验的驾驶者，在面对未知场景时能做出更合理的自主决策。 端到端模型的成熟并非一蹴而就，其底层逻辑是卓驭构建的“双闭环”研发范式：数据闭环通过对真实行车数据的回收、清洗与标注，不断喂养模型；体验闭环则是验证过的模型上车后，利用量产车源源不断回传的长尾问题和场景数据，反哺模型优化。 这种纯粹的数据驱动路径，解决了智驾体验从“可用”到“好用”的关键障碍——确定性。更深层的意义在于，这种进化是在不改变硬件平台的前提下实现的。 随着高悟性端到端 4.0 的发布，卓驭也明确了该技术将率先落地红旗“司南智驾”，并于今年上半年通过 OTA 陆续推送给红旗 HS6 PHEV、天工 05 等多款车型。

On March 13, autonomous driving solution provider Zhuoyu held an "Advanced End-to-End 4.0" experience day in Shenzhen. In this city known for its complex road conditions, Zhuoyu aimed to validate the real-world performance of its latest OTA version through tests in narrow roads of old urban areas and mixed-traffic streets. The tests revealed that Zhuoyu's End-to-End 4.0 exhibited distinct human-like characteristics when handling scenarios with unpredictable rules.  

A prime example is the system's understanding of negotiation. In narrow two-way single-lane gaps, the vehicle could engage in spatial negotiation with oncoming traffic, skillfully maneuvering around temporarily parked vehicles. The so-called "100% end-to-end" means that in the complete chain from perception to decision-making to control, the previously extensive reliance on manually preset rules has been replaced by AI models trained on massive datasets.
